title: SwiftDrop test report and test cases
baseline: baseline main bafb224 with operational changes verified before commit

cases.group: Authentication, approvals and account security
cases.title: Normalized customer signup
cases.data: Customer@Example.com with surrounding spaces; valid matching passwords.
cases.steps: Submit signup to the in-process auth API with the stub registration gateway.
cases.expected: HTTP 202; normalized name/email; requires email confirmation; no password or access token returned.
cases.actual: Assertions confirmed normalization, confirmation response and no-store/no-credential response.

cases.group: Authentication, approvals and account security
cases.title: Reject invalid signup and role escalation
cases.data: Empty name; invalid email; short/mismatched passwords; ADMIN/COURIER role; injected password_hash.
cases.steps: Submit each invalid variant and count registration-gateway calls.
cases.expected: HTTP 400 for every invalid variant; gateway is never called.
cases.actual: All invalid variants were rejected before provider access.

cases.group: Authentication, approvals and account security
cases.title: Login uses verified credentials and role
cases.data: Valid fixture email/password; wrong password; request containing role=ADMIN.
cases.steps: Send each login request to the auth router.
cases.expected: Valid credentials return 200; wrong password 401; client-selected role 400.
cases.actual: Expected HTTP status assertions passed.

cases.group: Authentication, approvals and account security
cases.title: Token, refresh and role boundaries
cases.data: Missing/expired token; valid customer access token; valid/expired refresh token.
cases.steps: Request /auth/me and a staff route; then attempt token refresh.
cases.expected: Invalid identity returns 401; customer receives own profile and is denied staff access; only valid refresh succeeds.
cases.actual: Profile, 401/403 and refresh assertions passed against the injected gateway.

cases.group: Authentication, approvals and account security
cases.title: Prevent direct profile escalation
cases.data: Two fixture auth users and app profiles; authenticated database role.
cases.steps: Read own/other profile; update safe fields; attempt role and credential access.
cases.expected: Own permitted profile operations succeed; other profiles, role escalation and password reads fail.
cases.actual: PGlite RLS assertions passed.

cases.group: Authentication, approvals and account security
cases.title: Reject expired, revoked and foreign sessions
cases.data: Fixture sessions: active, expired, removed and owned by another user.
cases.steps: Invoke the session validation function under each simulated identity/session.
cases.expected: Only the active session belonging to the current user is accepted; session records are not exposed.
cases.actual: All session validity and privacy assertions passed.

cases.group: Authentication, approvals and account security
cases.title: Partner applications cannot self-grant roles
cases.data: Courier application with vehicle details; business application with company details.
cases.steps: Submit registration applications and inspect forwarded application data and response.
cases.expected: Details are preserved; response requires approval; no operational role or access token is granted immediately.
cases.actual: Both application variants met the approval-boundary assertions.

cases.group: Authentication, approvals and account security
cases.title: Atomic staff approval
cases.data: Pending courier/merchant applications; active staff reviewer.
cases.steps: Approve the application through the tested database review function.
cases.expected: Role is granted, merchant row is created where appropriate, and reviewer is recorded atomically.
cases.actual: PGlite approval assertions passed for both roles.

cases.group: Authentication, approvals and account security
cases.title: Generic password reset and redirect protection
cases.data: Mixed-case email; malformed email; unexpected external redirectTo parameter.
cases.steps: Submit reset requests to the in-process auth API.
cases.expected: Email is normalized; valid request returns a generic response; invalid email/redirect injection returns 400.
cases.actual: Normalization and non-disclosure assertions passed.

cases.group: Authentication, approvals and account security
cases.title: Admin routes reject forged identity
cases.data: Missing, forged and expired tokens; CUSTOMER/COURIER/MERCHANT/DISPATCHER/ADMIN profiles.
cases.steps: Request the guarded admin test route with each identity.
cases.expected: Missing/forged identities get 401, non-admin roles 403, and verified admin 200.
cases.actual: The admin guard matrix passed.

cases.group: Customer booking, persisted pricing and migration
cases.title: Validate parcel/contact boundaries
cases.data: Valid contact/address fixture; weight 0 or 101 kg; negative dimension; dimension over 500 cm; invalid zone ID.
cases.steps: Parse valid and invalid requests through the actual Zod schemas.
cases.expected: Valid fixture passes; invalid contacts, weights, dimensions and zone ID fail.
cases.actual: All schema boundary assertions passed.

cases.group: Customer booking, persisted pricing and migration
cases.title: Persist booking and expose it to tracking/dispatch
cases.data: Two customer IDs; 2 kg parcel; default rates 350 + 50/kg + 20/km; 10 km estimate; client fee 0.01.
cases.steps: Create a booking; reopen the persistence service; list both customers; inspect history, public tracking and unassigned board.
cases.expected: Server fee is LKR 650; real tracking number persists; owner can list it; other customer cannot; CONFIRMED history/tracking and dispatch row exist.
cases.actual: Persistence, ownership, ignored client price, initial history and integration assertions passed.

cases.group: Customer booking, persisted pricing and migration
cases.title: Persist changes to global pricing
cases.data: Set base fee 500 and weight rate 100; 2 kg and 10 km.
cases.steps: Save rates, create a new quote and booking from a new service instance, then restore fixture settings.
cases.expected: Both next quote and booking use LKR 900.
cases.actual: New quote and persisted booking both matched 900.

cases.group: Customer booking, persisted pricing and migration
cases.title: Zone-specific pricing and disabled zones
cases.data: Zone base 1000; rate/kg 10; rate/km 1; 2 kg; 10 km.
cases.steps: Edit the zone; quote explicitly against its ID; disable it and retry.
cases.expected: Active zone quote is LKR 1030; disabled zone cannot be quoted.
cases.actual: Persisted zone and disabled-zone rejection assertions passed.

cases.group: Customer booking, persisted pricing and migration
cases.title: Derive booking owner from authenticated identity
cases.data: Anonymous caller; COURIER caller; CUSTOMER caller with forged customerId in body.
cases.steps: Call list/create routes using injected authentication and a recording persistence boundary.
cases.expected: Anonymous is 401; courier is 403; persistence receives the verified customer ID, not the body value.
cases.actual: HTTP and recorded-owner assertions passed.

cases.group: Customer booking, persisted pricing and migration
cases.title: No fabricated booking on storage failure
cases.data: Persistence boundary throws an error containing private detail.
cases.steps: Call quote/create routes with valid data while storage fails.
cases.expected: HTTP 503; no confirmation or synthetic tracking number; private detail not returned.
cases.actual: Both endpoints returned the expected safe errors.

cases.group: Customer booking, persisted pricing and migration
cases.title: Repeat operational migration safely
cases.data: Populated isolated database with the feature migration already applied.
cases.steps: Apply the same operational migration again; query existing customer bookings.
cases.expected: Migration succeeds and existing operational records remain.
cases.actual: Reapplication and preserved-data assertions passed.

cases.group: Courier execution, dispatch and user administration
cases.title: Real parcel assignment and valid delivery pipeline
cases.data: Persisted booking; verified courier/admin fixture IDs.
cases.steps: Assign the parcel; list jobs; advance PICKED_UP, IN_TRANSIT, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY; upload proof; mark DELIVERED.
cases.expected: Parcel is assigned and visible to its courier; valid transitions persist; tracking reaches DELIVERED.
cases.actual: Database service and public-tracking assertions passed.

cases.group: Courier execution, dispatch and user administration
cases.title: Courier isolation and mandatory proof
cases.data: Assigned parcel; a second courier; no proof initially.
cases.steps: Request/update/upload proof as the other courier; attempt delivery before proof; retry after a proof record.
cases.expected: Foreign courier cannot read/update/upload; DELIVERED requires proof; terminal transition back to IN_TRANSIT is rejected.
cases.actual: Assignment ownership, proof requirement and terminal-state assertions passed.

cases.group: Courier execution, dispatch and user administration
cases.title: Today-only assigned jobs
cases.data: Assigned parcel whose assigned_at is moved back two days.
cases.steps: List the courier jobs through the database service.
cases.expected: The old assignment is excluded from today’s list.
cases.actual: Daily-filter assertion passed.

cases.group: Courier execution, dispatch and user administration
cases.title: Capacity and duplicate assignment protection
cases.data: Capacity=1; two unassigned parcels; two couriers.
cases.steps: Assign the first parcel; attempt a second assignment to the full courier and another assignment of the first parcel.
cases.expected: Capacity and duplicate assignment attempts fail; only one active assignment remains.
cases.actual: Sequential database-function capacity/duplicate assertions passed. Parallel multi-connection contention was not exercised.

cases.group: Courier execution, dispatch and user administration
cases.title: Persist failed delivery reason
cases.data: Assigned parcel advanced to PICKED_UP; blank reason then RECIPIENT_UNAVAILABLE.
cases.steps: Attempt failure with blank reason; retry with a valid reason; query public tracking.
cases.expected: Blank reason is rejected; valid failure persists and public status becomes FAILED.
cases.actual: Reason and FAILED tracking assertions passed.

cases.group: Courier execution, dispatch and user administration
cases.title: Protected user administration
cases.data: Admin actor; courier actor; another customer account.
cases.steps: Attempt admin self-deactivation and non-admin update; then deactivate/rename another customer as admin.
cases.expected: Self-deactivation and non-admin action fail; authorized update persists inactive state and new name.
cases.actual: Database function assertions passed. Admin browser interaction and last-admin concurrent scenarios remain manual.

cases.group: Courier execution, dispatch and user administration
cases.title: Block public Data API access and retain server access
cases.data: anon, authenticated and service_role database roles; operational tables and functions.
cases.steps: Inspect public-client SELECT/EXECUTE privileges and server-role privileges for both functions and the three new tables.
cases.expected: Public client roles cannot bypass the API; service_role retains the intended operational function/table access.
cases.actual: Public-client denial and explicit server-role access assertions passed.

cases.group: Notifications and preference enforcement
cases.title: Mock SMS preferences and duplicate suppression
cases.data: Customer with SMS enabled; captured booking event; then SMS disabled.
cases.steps: Process the same event twice; count mock messages; disable SMS and process another event.
cases.expected: First event creates one durable mock message; duplicate creates none; disabled SMS produces no additional message.
cases.actual: Durable mock mailbox count remained one. No real SMS delivery was tested.

cases.group: Notifications and preference enforcement
cases.title: Fan out assignment notifications per recipient
cases.data: Customer and active assigned courier with different channel preferences.
cases.steps: Process COURIER_ASSIGNED and inspect recipient notification/channel records.
cases.expected: One notification per eligible recipient; each recipient’s preferences determine channel intent.
cases.actual: Database fan-out and preference assertions passed.

cases.group: Notifications and preference enforcement
cases.title: Concurrent duplicate event processing
cases.data: One parcel event delivered concurrently more than once.
cases.steps: Process the identical event concurrently, then inspect stored notification count.
cases.expected: Unique recipient/event rules prevent duplicate inbox records.
cases.actual: Concurrent idempotency assertion passed.

cases.group: Notifications and preference enforcement
cases.title: Private customer/courier inbox
cases.data: Two customers and a courier; each has different notification rows.
cases.steps: Read own inbox; attempt to read or modify another user’s notification.
cases.expected: Only own records are returned; foreign access is hidden/rejected.
cases.actual: Owner-isolation assertions passed.

cases.group: Notifications and preference enforcement
cases.title: Stable cursor pagination
cases.data: Multiple notifications including equal created_at timestamps.
cases.steps: Read successive pages using returned keyset cursors.
cases.expected: Pages neither duplicate nor skip rows, including timestamp ties.
cases.actual: Equal-timestamp keyset assertion passed.

cases.group: Notifications and preference enforcement
cases.title: Read/unread filtering and counts
cases.data: Read and unread notifications of several types.
cases.steps: Apply read/type filters and request unread count for the caller.
cases.expected: Filters return matching records; count is scoped to the caller.
cases.actual: The recorded filter and per-user unread-count checks passed.

cases.group: Notifications and preference enforcement
cases.title: Idempotent mark-read actions
cases.data: Unread inbox records belonging to the caller.
cases.steps: Mark one record read twice; then mark remaining records read twice.
cases.expected: Read state updates only within the caller’s inbox; repeating the action is safe.
cases.actual: Single-read and read-all checks passed.

cases.group: Notifications and preference enforcement
cases.title: Preference validation and isolation
cases.data: Partial preference changes; invalid value types, unknown fields and empty payload.
cases.steps: Save valid partial changes; submit invalid variants; reload the user’s preferences.
cases.expected: Valid fields persist per user; invalid writes are rejected without changing saved state.
cases.actual: Partial-persistence and invalid-payload checks passed.

cases.group: Asynchronous events, publisher and consumer recovery
cases.title: Complete merchant status-event contract
cases.data: Database parcel linked to a merchant; assigned courier.
cases.steps: Change parcel status through assignment; inspect the captured outbox payload.
cases.expected: Payload includes stable eventId, merchantId, parcel ID and tracking/status data.
cases.actual: Merchant/event contract assertions passed.

cases.group: Asynchronous events, publisher and consumer recovery
cases.title: Outbox requires broker confirmations
cases.data: Pending outbox events; mocked notification publish succeeds; mocked webhook publish initially fails.
cases.steps: Flush once with missing webhook confirmation; flush again with both confirms.
cases.expected: Unconfirmed event remains pending; published_at is set only after required confirms.
cases.actual: Pending/published database-state assertions passed. Live RabbitMQ was not used.

cases.group: Asynchronous events, publisher and consumer recovery
cases.title: Lazy shared publisher initialization
cases.data: Fake confirm channel; concurrent publish calls.
cases.steps: Create publisher without publishing; issue concurrent publishes; inspect channel/initialization calls.
cases.expected: Connection is lazy; concurrent calls share initialization and preserve the payload/queue.
cases.actual: Publisher lazy/reuse/concurrency checks passed.

cases.group: Asynchronous events, publisher and consumer recovery
cases.title: Publisher nack and confirmation timeout
cases.data: Fake channel sends nack, or never confirms.
cases.steps: Publish and inspect returned status, channel closure and next initialization.
cases.expected: Publish fails safely; failed channel is invalidated; timeout does not imply delivery.
cases.actual: Nack and confirmation-timeout tests passed.

cases.group: Asynchronous events, publisher and consumer recovery
cases.title: Acknowledge only after successful processing
cases.data: Valid event and a controlled notification processor.
cases.steps: Delay processing, then complete it; inspect consumer acknowledgement order.
cases.expected: No acknowledgement occurs before successful processing.
cases.actual: Acknowledgement-order assertion passed.

cases.group: Asynchronous events, publisher and consumer recovery
cases.title: Malformed events go to the dead-letter path
cases.data: Invalid JSON and schema-invalid event fixtures.
cases.steps: Feed invalid payloads to the consumer handler with a fake confirm channel.
cases.expected: Confirmed DLQ copy precedes acknowledgement; poison messages do not loop indefinitely.
cases.actual: Malformed JSON and schema-invalid DLQ tests passed.

cases.group: Asynchronous events, publisher and consumer recovery
cases.title: Do not acknowledge unconfirmed retry/DLQ copies
cases.data: Processing failure; fake publisher fails retry or DLQ confirmation.
cases.steps: Attempt retry/dead-letter publication and inspect acknowledgement state.
cases.expected: Original message remains unacknowledged when the durable copy is not confirmed.
cases.actual: Both retry and DLQ failure cases passed.

cases.group: Asynchronous events, publisher and consumer recovery
cases.title: Reconnect supervision and clean shutdown
cases.data: Fake channel lifecycle and controlled scheduler.
cases.steps: Trigger repeated disconnects; advance timers; reconnect; stop during wait or connection startup.
cases.expected: One reconnect loop; exponential delay capped at 30 seconds; stop prevents late consumers.
cases.actual: Consumer supervisor backoff, deduplication and stop cases passed.

cases.group: Web client session, tracking and display behavior
cases.title: One refresh for concurrent expired-token requests
cases.data: Mocked expired access token and multiple concurrent requests.
cases.steps: Start requests together, return 401, then complete a single refresh.
cases.expected: Refresh rotates once; requests retry once with the new token.
cases.actual: Shared-refresh test passed.

cases.group: Web client session, tracking and display behavior
cases.title: Logout prevents late session restoration
cases.data: Deferred login/profile/refresh results and a logout in between.
cases.steps: Start the delayed operation; sign out; then complete the stale response.
cases.expected: Old account state cannot be restored and no authenticated retry occurs after logout.
cases.actual: Recorded logout/login/profile/refresh race checks passed.

cases.group: Web client session, tracking and display behavior
cases.title: OAuth callback cannot grant a role from URL data
cases.data: Mock provider session; forged URL role/redirect data; cancelled callback.
cases.steps: Complete the callback and load the backend-verified profile; exercise cancellation.
cases.expected: Application trusts verified identity only; cancelled flow never restores a session.
cases.actual: Callback trust and cancellation checks passed. This was not a live Google login.

cases.group: Web client session, tracking and display behavior
cases.title: Role-aware workspace routing
cases.data: Verified profiles for all roles; pending/rejected applications.
cases.steps: Resolve the dashboard route for each profile.
cases.expected: Roles reach their own workspace; unapproved applicants remain on approval.
cases.actual: Dashboard routing assertions passed.

cases.group: Web client session, tracking and display behavior
cases.title: Public tracking request and route input safety
cases.data: Mixed-case tracking number; malformed percent-escaped route parameter.
cases.steps: Normalize input; issue public lookup; decode malformed route data.
cases.expected: Tracking format is validated; public lookup sends no credentials; malformed escapes do not throw.
cases.actual: Tracking normalization, public request and route-decoding checks passed.

cases.group: Web client session, tracking and display behavior
cases.title: Notification list merging and query encoding
cases.data: Overlapping notification pages and opaque cursor values.
cases.steps: Build the list query and merge pages containing repeated IDs.
cases.expected: Unset filters are omitted; cursor is encoded; duplicate IDs are not appended.
cases.actual: Query-helper and merge checks passed.

cases.group: Mobile client storage, auth and booking behavior
cases.title: Atomic secure storage of large sessions
cases.data: Large Unicode session; failed and successful token rotations.
cases.steps: Store chunked credentials; simulate a rotation write failure; read session; repeat successful rotation and logout.
cases.expected: Old committed session survives incomplete rotation; successful rotation/logout remove superseded chunks.
cases.actual: Secure-storage round-trip, rotation and cleanup checks passed. Real-device secure storage was simulated.

cases.group: Mobile client storage, auth and booking behavior
cases.title: Expiry and account-switch race protection
cases.data: Expired session; delayed old login; newer courier login; logout.
cases.steps: Advance expiry and complete stale responses after logout/account switching.
cases.expected: Expired credentials clear; an older operation cannot overwrite the new identity or restore a signed-out account.
cases.actual: Mobile expiry, logout and account-switch checks passed.

cases.group: Mobile client storage, auth and booking behavior
cases.title: Restrict the native app to permitted roles
cases.data: Customer/courier profiles and merchant/dispatcher profiles.
cases.steps: Attempt to establish a mobile application session for each role.
cases.expected: Merchant/dispatcher roles cannot enter the customer/courier shell.
cases.actual: Mobile role-restriction assertion passed.

cases.group: Mobile client storage, auth and booking behavior
cases.title: Foreground/background refresh lifecycle
cases.data: Mock application foreground/background transitions and API profile verification.
cases.steps: Move to foreground, then background; inspect refresh and revalidation calls.
cases.expected: Foreground starts refresh/revalidates; background stops automatic refresh.
cases.actual: Lifecycle assertions passed.

cases.group: Mobile client storage, auth and booking behavior
cases.title: Use server quote and real booking confirmation
cases.data: 2 kg with parcel dimensions; server quote LKR 650; failed or incomplete booking responses.
cases.steps: Call booking client; inspect forwarded payload; return server failure/incomplete success; then valid real tracking number.
cases.expected: Client uses server currency/price and never invents a quote or tracking number.
cases.actual: All four recorded booking-client tests passed.

cases.group: Mobile client storage, auth and booking behavior
cases.title: Verify PKCE identity before persisting OAuth session
cases.data: Mock valid, cancelled, unregistered and expired-code callbacks.
cases.steps: Run callback exchange and role-verification branches.
cases.expected: Only permitted backend-verified identity is persisted; cancelled/invalid callbacks do not save a session.
cases.actual: Google callback/exchange and persistence checks passed. Provider interaction was mocked.

cases.group: Webhook transport and generative assistant
cases.title: Durable signed webhook retry and event deduplication
cases.data: Mock receiver returns 503 then 204; stable event ID; configured test endpoint/secret.
cases.steps: Dispatch once; resend identical event; recreate service; make retry due; retry; attempt access as another merchant.
cases.expected: Initial attempt persists; duplicate does not resend; restart reloads retry; signature verifies; retry succeeds with same payload; foreign merchant is denied.
cases.actual: Attempt counts, HMAC signature, payload stability, 204 success and merchant isolation assertions passed.

cases.group: Webhook transport and generative assistant
cases.title: Reject private webhook targets
cases.data: Loopback/private IPv4 and IPv6; URL credentials; fake DNS resolving to 10.0.0.1, then public address.
cases.steps: Validate each URL/address and mocked resolver response.
cases.expected: Local/private/credential-bearing targets are rejected; public target passes validation.
cases.actual: Address and mocked-DNS assertions passed. Live egress/DNS-rebinding behavior was not exercised.

cases.group: Webhook transport and generative assistant
cases.title: Assistant calls tracking tool before answering
cases.data: Mock model requests trackParcel for SWIFT-AB12CD34; tool returns IN_TRANSIT.
cases.steps: Run the AI SDK agent; inspect executed tool arguments and the model’s next prompt.
cases.expected: Exactly the requested backend tracking tool executes; tool result is provided to the next model step.
cases.actual: Two-step mocked-model loop and backend tool invocation assertions passed.

cases.group: Webhook transport and generative assistant
cases.title: Assistant does not invent a destination zone
cases.data: Question: 2 kg to Kandy; only Colombo zone configured.
cases.steps: Mock the model requesting a quote for Kandy; inspect tool result and pricing invocation.
cases.expected: Tool returns destination-unavailable plus available zones; pricing is not invoked against a manufactured zone.
cases.actual: Destination guard assertions passed. No live model answer was tested.

manual.title: Real Google login
manual.preconditions: Configured Google OAuth credentials and callback allowlist; user-controlled browser.
manual.steps: Choose Google login; complete consent/callback; reload and log out.
manual.expected: Only verified account enters the correct workspace; logout revokes its session.
manual.actual: No live provider/browser execution is recorded.

manual.title: Complete customer booking browser journey
manual.preconditions: Feature migration applied to dedicated test database; web/API/worker running.
manual.data: Disposable customer; valid sender/recipient and parcel data.
manual.steps: Sign in; obtain fee; confirm booking; open history, receipt and tracking.
manual.expected: Same real parcel is visible across all screens; receipt is owner-scoped and download works.
manual.actual: Database services were tested; full browser journey was not recorded.

manual.title: Merchant partner API and delivered webhook
manual.preconditions: Approved disposable merchant; API key; reachable receiver; broker/worker.
manual.data: Merchant order and receiver capable of verifying the signature.
manual.steps: Create order using X-API-Key; assign/update status; receive webhook; verify HMAC/event ID.
manual.expected: Order belongs to merchant and receiver obtains the matching authenticated update.
manual.actual: Full live partner API-to-broker-to-receiver execution is not recorded.

manual.title: Native camera proof and failed delivery
manual.preconditions: Physical device/development build with camera permissions and reachable API.
manual.data: Assigned disposable parcel; real photo; failure reason.
manual.steps: Capture/upload photo and complete delivery; separately record a failure; check server state.
manual.expected: Actual uploaded image and state persist; denied permissions or network errors cannot show false success.
manual.actual: Camera and device behavior were not executed on real hardware.

manual.title: RabbitMQ outage/recovery and worker restart
manual.preconditions: Dedicated RabbitMQ vhost and database; broker management access.
manual.data: Several status events while broker is offline.
manual.steps: Stop broker; change statuses; inspect pending outbox; restart broker/worker; replay event.
manual.expected: No event is lost after confirmations; consumers deduplicate and process pending events.
manual.actual: Recorded tests mock broker confirmations and lifecycle.

manual.title: Hosted Supabase auth/profile integration
manual.preconditions: New migration applied only to intended dedicated test project.
manual.data: Anonymous, customer, courier, merchant and admin sessions.
manual.steps: Test actual REST table access, profile loading, role boundaries and deactivation.
manual.expected: Operational Data API access is denied while permitted own-profile reads and app routes work.
manual.actual: PGlite assertions do not replace live Supabase policy/provider verification.

manual.title: Receipt and image access in browser
manual.preconditions: Dedicated data with two customer/courier identities and an uploaded image.
manual.steps: Download own receipt/proof; attempt direct unauthenticated and cross-user access.
manual.expected: Owned/staff access works; foreign/direct public access is denied with no personal data leakage.
manual.actual: No complete browser file-download/access test is recorded.

manual.title: Admin settings and account management UI
manual.preconditions: Dedicated admin and disposable second user; configured zones.
manual.data: Updated global/zone rates; user activation toggle.
manual.steps: Save pricing; reload; quote from customer/merchant; deactivate/reactivate disposable user.
manual.expected: Changes persist and affect quotes; deactivated identity loses access; self-deactivation is blocked.
manual.actual: Backend functions were tested; browser activation and price-management interaction are unverified.

manual.title: Configured generative AI provider
manual.preconditions: Provider key and supported AI_MODEL_NAME; dedicated app data.
manual.data: Known tracking number and configured/unconfigured destination quote questions.
manual.steps: Ask in /assistant; inspect server/tool requests and answer accuracy; simulate provider failure.
manual.expected: Live answers use real tool results; unavailable provider yields an explicit error.
manual.actual: Only mocked-model agent tests are recorded.

manual.title: Fresh Docker/Supabase container setup
manual.preconditions: Docker available; ports/resources free; separate test environment.
manual.data: Generated local schema and valid local Supabase settings.
manual.steps: Sync schema; start local Supabase and Compose; verify service health and one complete delivery flow.
manual.expected: Database/auth/frontend/API/broker/worker work together from a fresh installation.
manual.actual: Compose configuration was validated; images and the full stack were not started.

manual.title: Full Kubernetes deployment
manual.preconditions: Configured cluster, images, secrets, storage, Auth/database and ingress.
manual.data: Dedicated namespace and disposable delivery data.
manual.steps: Deploy; verify rollout/health; execute customer/merchant/courier and recovery flows.
manual.expected: Full cluster workflow works and survives relevant pod restarts.
manual.actual: No cluster deployment or live Kubernetes evidence is recorded.

manual.title: Concurrent assignment and last-admin contention
manual.preconditions: Dedicated PostgreSQL with multiple independent connections.
manual.data: Two dispatchers competing for a capacity-limited courier; two admin updates.
manual.steps: Race assignment operations; race changes involving the final active administrator.
manual.expected: Capacity is never exceeded; one active assignment per parcel; final active admin remains protected.
manual.actual: Existing integration checks are sequential in a single isolated PGlite instance.

groupPreconditions.Authentication, approvals and account se: In-process Express auth/admin routers, injected auth gateway and/or isolated PGlite auth-schema fixtures. Tokens, credentials and role claims are test doubles; no real Google/Supabase login is performed.
groupPreconditions.Customer booking, persisted pricing and: Fresh isolated PGlite database with base, notification-hardening and operational migrations; random fixture IDs and example.invalid email addresses. HTTP-boundary cases inject authentication/storage. No hosted database is changed.
groupPreconditions.Courier execution, dispatch and user adm: Same isolated operational database with customer/courier/admin/merchant fixtures. Database services are real; network and browser/device interaction are not part of these cases.
groupPreconditions.Notifications and preference enforcement: Isolated notification fixtures with multiple users, notification records and preference rows. Inbox API identity is injected. Mock SMS is a durable simulated mailbox, not a phone provider.
groupPreconditions.Asynchronous events, publisher and consu: Controlled fake broker channels, confirm responses, clocks and schedulers, or an isolated database outbox. These are deterministic integration/unit checks, not live RabbitMQ execution.
groupPreconditions.Web client session, tracking and display: Actual transpiled web auth/tracking/notification client modules run in Node VM harnesses with mocked storage/fetch/provider boundaries. No browser rendering or visual accessibility audit is implied.
groupPreconditions.Mobile client storage, auth and booking: Actual transpiled mobile service modules run with mocked secure-storage, provider and network boundaries. Camera/device hardware and native UI rendering are outside the recorded run.
groupPreconditions.Webhook transport and generative assista: Webhook HTTP transport and DNS resolver are mocked in an isolated database test. The assistant uses AI SDK MockLanguageModelV4 plus controlled backend tool seams; no paid/live model call is performed.
